data.keep_history: Keep removed shipments in the history
data.history_days: Delete from the history after (days, 0 = never)

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: A courier gets one request per interval: with 15 minutes, 1 shipment is checked every 15 minutes, 2 every 30, and so on up to 1 hour. ACS and Geniki check all their shipments together. Minimum 15.
data_description.auto_remove_delivered: Delivered shipments are removed this many days after delivery. 0 keeps them.
data_description.keep_history: A removed shipment (from the card, the to-do list, an action or the automatic clean-up of deliveries) stays in the card's History as it was: no more checks. Off: removing deletes it.
data_description.history_days: Shipments are deleted from the history this many days after they were removed. With 0 they stay until you delete them from the card.
data_description.no_movement_days: When a shipment has no new update for this many days, the card says so and the integration fires greek_courier_tracker_no_movement once (the notification blueprint can send it to your phones). 0 turns it off.
